verdict.rationale: Airbyte has a dedicated first-party Typing and Deduping doc page promising one-to-one stream-to-table mapping in the warehouse with no sub-tables. Its sync-mode docs govern how data is written to destinations, which points to typed, deduplicated final tables rather than raw JSON. However, the quoted snippets only cover the table-mapping point, and the typing and dedup behaviour is inferred mostly from the page's title and URL. missing for 10: explicit evidence of typed column casting and primary-key deduplication behaviour in the snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration that final tables are query-ready.
